verdictBody: All three indicators remain well below their recession thresholds. Initial and continued claims are near 2026 lows and payroll growth continued in October, with August and September revised up a combined 84K.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims eased to 1.697M (week of Nov 14) after a brief early-November spike, alongside a steady insured unemployment rate of 1.1%.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Continued claims stayed near 2026 lows while nonfarm payrolls rose 165K in October, keeping the ratio well under trigger.

indicators.name: I
indicators.readout: Initial claims fell to 189K (week of Nov 21), a new low for the year, against continued payroll gains.
